name: VerveDo
tagline: A concise to-do app that follows Material 3 Expressive.
blurb: VerveDo is a concise to-do app that follows Material 3 Expressive.
description: VerveDo is a concise to-do app that follows Material 3 Expressive. You can use it to keep track of your daily school homeworks or as a memo for everyday life. You can set priorities to each task and sort them, helping you stay organized and in control of your life.
